intake_questions.before_times: The language pair; the kind of appointment in general words only (medical, legal or court, school, business, personal), since it sets who may go (a certificate) and how long; the date, start time and expected length; for documents, how many pages and the date they're needed by (a need-by date).
intake_questions.after_time: Name and mobile of the person booking; for on-site work, the address and who the interpreter meets there (a front desk, a clinician, the person served).
intake_questions.secure_page_only: The person served's name and any details of the case, the health visit or the legal matter; the documents themselves (photos of pages); a preference for a woman or a man interpreter, where the plug-in allows it (A4-16).
intake_questions.who_may_book: An adult for themselves; an organization (a clinic, a law office, a school, a court, a company) for the person it serves; a parent for a child's documents. A teen can't book alone.

safety_and_stop_words.stop: A medical emergency or danger described in the request (an interpreter is no emergency service).
safety_and_stop_words.what_rosie_says: 'If anyone is in danger, call 911 now. 911 can connect an interpreter.' No booking during an emergency.

first_steps_and_forms.prep: On-site: the interpreter arrives 15 minutes early and checks in at the front desk. Documents: bring the original.
first_steps_and_forms.required: Documents: photos of every page before the price (the photo quote). Court and medical work: the interpreter's certificate on file before they're offered.

staff.skills: Each person's language pairs and certificates (court, medical); only people whose pairs and certificates fit are offered.

children_and_age.who_may_book: An adult for themselves; an organization (a clinic, a law office, a school, a court, a company) for the person it serves; a parent for a child's documents. A teen can't book alone.

visit.done: DONE from the interpreter (B, video); the code at the office (documents).

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).

never_in_a_text: What the appointment is about (a diagnosis, a court case, an immigration matter), the person served's name for an organization's booking, and anything in the documents. Texts say only 'your interpreting visit' or 'your translation'.
languages: The business's language pairs (example: Spanish, Vietnamese and Arabic with English). Texts go in the customer's language where Rosie can use it; a person follows up otherwise.
